title: Intraday momentum in commodity futures (first hour predicts last hour; Gao, Han, Li and Zhou 2018, commodity replications), Topstep-compatible
rule: hourly roll-safe bars (ET bar start): energy CL/NG/RB/HO first 09:00, last 13:00; metals GC/SI/HG first 08:00, last 12:00; grains ZC/ZS/ZW first 09:00, last 13:00; position sign(first-hour return) during the last bar (same contract); 2 x cost_frac per trade; equal weight 1/n per root per day
grid: filter {none; only when |first-hour return| > 1 sd of the past 60 first-hour returns}
if pass: also judged as an entrant of the EQR book vs 1.143 (one evaluation)
